findings.status: Production API retains preparation. Android retry, cold reopen, and group-size/notes round trip passed.

findings.status: Deployed e36f7f70. Two distinct GPS recaps linked to the same trip synced and reopened with private track maps/statistics.
Main trip forms and access-point modal now use keyboard avoidance; low custom-route field scrolls above the keyboard on the phone.

findings.issue: Past paddle inherits a future trip date and launch time
findings.status: Defaults to trip-local today and empty launch time for a future plan; past plan dates remain reusable.

findings.issue: Route validation remains visible after changing the route
findings.status: Clear route-specific validation on route changes; a custom route now uses the correct Choose app route label.

findings.issue: Finishing a recording claims the track synced privately even when sync failed
findings.status: Explicitly says the track is saved on this device and has not synced when pending work remains.

findings.issue: Sync recovery displays a large raw JSON payload and generic confirmation labels
findings.status: Readable recovery fields and explicit keep/retry/discard controls verified on phone. Vehicle saves also clear old notices.

coverageLimits: Stationary recording checks controls and persistence, not distance accuracy during a real paddle
No second account was used on the phone, so invitation acceptance, concurrent edits, and ownership transfer were not tested end to end
No share sheet recipient was selected and no messages were sent
Existing sign-in session was preserved; fresh Google/email sign-in and account switching were not exercised
Offline-download navigation was checked, but downloading and airplane-mode packet operation were outside this My Trips walkthrough
iOS and native accessibility text scaling were not tested

cleanup.locationPermissions: Fine and coarse location denied again, matching original grant state

followUp.simplifiedShuttle: Removed seat counts, seat selection, passenger assignments, and ride-capacity summaries from Android and web UI. Retained vehicles/drivers and optional meeting, parking, and notes.
followUp.syncRecovery: Readable saved fields, private track statistics without coordinates, contextual review labels, Retry sync, Keep changes and close, and explicit discard confirmation. Retry retains unresolved work.
followUp.recordingRecovery: Android task registration survives a force-stop. Cold process recovery now stops stale registration and pauses the saved track. Resume requests expired location permission again. Interruption time is excluded after the last saved location. A live checkpoint also retains stationary recording time while the app is open.
followUp.localVehicleUpdates: Vehicle additions, edits, and removals are durable and visible locally while sync is unavailable.
